text: Machine learning kya hai? Machine learning data par ek algorithm train karne ki process hai. Is baat ka kya matlab hua? Aapke paas bahut sara data hai. Let us say 3 billion data points aapke paas hain. Aur ab aap log chahte ho ki aap log un 3 billion data points ko dekhte hue naye data points ke baare mein prediction kar sako. Now let us say mere paas data hai ki hawa kitni tez chal rahi thi, mere paas data hai ki precipitation kitna tha, humidity kitni thi, aur temperature kitna tha us din, aur mujhe predict karna hai ki whether it is going to rain or not? Main kar sakta hoon aisa using machine learning algorithms. Kis tarah se main karunga prediction? Main karunga ek machine learning algorithm ko wo purana data dikha kar. Toh main kahunga yaar jab precipitation itna, humidity itni, temperature itna tab rain hua tha. Precipitation, humidity, temperature itna toh rain nahi hua tha. Phir main jab nayi value dunga ki bhai aaj ka precipitation, humidity aur temperature ye hai, toh uske aadhar par mujhe wo bata dega ki yaar ye jo value hai iske hisaab se aaj baarish nahi hone wali hai, aaj baarish hone wali hai. Kya wo sach hoga? Nahi wo ek prediction hoga. Toh jo machine learning and AI karta hai wo predictions karta hai. Ye bahut simple si prediction ki baat kar di hai maine, lekin isi cheez ko ek next level par agar aap log lekar jao deep learning ke through...

text: ...aap log agar complex algorithms ko train karo, tab wahan par dekha ye jata hai ki complex algorithms par train karke ye process itni khatarnak ban jati hai ki humans bhi amaze ho jate hain. text: Ab hum is baat par wapas aate hain ki machine learning kya hoti hai. Toh data ko dikha kar hum prediction kar sakte hain machine learning ki sahayata se ye toh maine aap logo ko abhi bataya. Lekin machine learning hoti hai teen prakar ki agar sirf machine learning ki baat karoon. Supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement learning. Supervised learning mein kya hota hai ki aap logo ke paas kuch input hain, ek output hai ya multiple outputs bhi ho sakte hain, aur aapke paas is tarah ka organized data hai. Jaise ki maine aap logo ko bataya tha precipitation, humidity aur temperature ke aadhar par hum predict kar rahe the rain yes aur no. Agar mere paas aisa bahut sara data hai phir naye precipitation, humidity aur temperature ki values mere paas hain, toh main uske aadhar par ye pata laga sakta hoon ki kya rain hogi ya nahi hogi. Ya koi insaan ke agar kuch parameters mere paas hain, health parameters let us say uska blood pressure, let us say uski blood glucose, usi ke saath saath uska HbA1c ye saari cheezein agar mere paas hain toh main pata laga sakta hoon ki wo diabetic hai ki nahi. Agar main isko ek machine learning algorithm se run karunga toh patient ke baare mein ek bahut achi jankari main nikal sakta hoon, ek presumption nikal sakta hoon ki usko diabetes ho sakta hai ki nahi aur uske aadhar par main test wagerah kar sakta hoon. Toh medical and healthcare mein bhi iska bahut zyada istemal badh raha hai kyunki generative AI bahut zyada manual work bacha raha hai.
title: Machine Learning Explained

text: Toh supervised learning mein kya hota hai ki aapke paas jo input hain wo hote hain, output aapka specified hota hai ki bhai ye output hai. Unsupervised learning mein aapke paas data hota hai aur us data pe aapko ek algorithm ko is prakar se train karna hota hai ki algorithm aap logo ko batata hai ki ye data kis tarah se organize kiya ja sakta hai. For example, main clustering kar sakta hoon, mere paas bahut saare data points hain aur main ye pata lagana chahta hoon ki inme se kaun se data points ek doosre se related hain aur kitna zyada related hain, toh main K-Means clustering algorithm ka istemal kar sakta hoon. Ya phir main aur bhi bahut saare unsupervised algorithms hain jinka use karke clustering kar sakta hoon aur ek data ko kuch labels mein classify kar sakta hoon aur wo labels main khud se generate kar sakta hoon. Generative AI mein aur NLP mein ye sab cheezein bahut zyada istemal hoti hain ek baar data neural networks se ho kar aa jata hai toh. Toh jo supervised learning hoti hai usme labelled examples ka use hota hai aur jo unsupervised learning hoti hai usme unlabelled examples ka use hota hai. Ek aur unsupervised learning ka example hai credit card ka fraud detection ki kaunsa credit card ka fraud yahan par, kaunsa transaction jo hai wo ek fraudulent transaction ho sakta hai based on kis IP se wo ho raha hai, kahan se ho raha hai. Is tarah ki cheezein jo hai unsupervised learning mein aap logo ko dekhne ko milengi. Phir iske baad ek aur category hai reinforcement learning. Reinforcement learning mein kya hota hai ki hum log ek agent ko chhod dete hain data collect karne ke liye. Toh wo kya karta hai agent, trial and error karta hai aur us trial and error ke aadhar par usko ya toh rewards milte hain ya usko penalty milti hai aur wo kya karta hai, apne rewards ko maximize karta hai. Aur uske baad wo sirf wahi kaam karta hai jisse uska reward maximize ho aur wo khud is cheez ko jaan leta hai ki mujhe aisa kaunsa kaam karna chahiye jisse ki mera reward jo hai wo maximize ho.
title: Machine Learning Explained

text: Ab ek machine learning algorithm ko kisi ek data pe run karne ke liye ek overall process kya hoti hai? Aap log kis tarah ki process se guzrenge agar aap log ek machine learning algorithm se model ko train karna chahte hain? Pehla step hota hai data collection jisme aap log data ko collect karte hain. Ab aapka data agar kisi database mein maujood hai toh wahan se aap data ko pull karke desired format mein lekar aayenge. Aur jo doosri step hai data collection ke baad, wo hoti hai data preprocessing jisme ki aap log cleanup karenge data ko. Aur cleanup karne ke baad usko ek aise format mein layenge such that it can be consumed by a machine learning algorithm. Iske baad hota hai model selection jisme aap ek paryapt model ko select karenge ya phir kabhi kabhi hum bahut saare models ka prayog karte hain. Aur iske liye packages like scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, in sabka prayog kiya jata hai. Phir iske baad hum log apne model ko train karte hain. Ye ek process kabhi kabhi bahut zyada time leti hai, kabhi kabhi ye bahut kam time mein bhi ho jati hai depending upon which algorithm we are using, how many data points we have aur kis tarah ke data points hain. Kabhi kabhi hamare data points hi is tarah ke bade bade vectors hote hain ki agar kam bhi hue na uske baad bhi time bahut zyada lag jata hai. Iske baad hum testing and evaluation karte hain jisme ki hum apne model ko test karte hain aur ye pata lagate hain ki jo hamara model bana hai wo kitna behtar bana hai. Aur usko behtar banane ke liye hum kya kar sakte hain. Humein ek accuracy ka number milta hai aur accuracy ko agar hum kisi doosre algorithm se maximize kar sakte hain, toh hum wo karenge. Iske baad hum predictions karte hain aur predictions karne ke baad model ko hum production mein daal dete hain. Aur production mein daalne ke baad hum us model ko update karte rehte hain jaise jaise hamare paas data aata jayega. Toh ye process jo hai wo iteratively chalti rehti hai, repeatedly chalti rehti hai.
title: Machine Learning Explained

text: Ab hamare paas kuch common metrics hote hain machine learning algorithms ko evaluate karne ke liye. Jaise ki ek hamare paas metric hota hai ROC AUC curve. Usi ke saath saath hamare paas ek accuracy hota hai, ek precision hota hai, recall hota hai, F1 score hota hai, confusion matrix hoti hai, mean absolute error, R squared error. Ye sab kya hote hain ye aap log ek baar jaan jate hain toh aap apne model ko bahut closely evaluate kar payenge. Aur ye pata laga payenge ki kaunsa model aap logo ke liye paryapt hai jab aap industry mein ya phir production mein apne model ko daalna chahte ho. Basics always remain the same, lekin kis tarah se aap log deploy kar rahe ho such that ki jo aapki service hai wo down nahi hoti hai, aapko downtime bilkul bhi nahi milta hai aur aapko ek aisa managed environment milta hai jisse ki aap apne model ko retrain kar paa rahe ho, production mein daal paa rahe ho, aapko dikkat nahi ho rahi hai. text: Ab aap kahoge ki yaar ye basic machine learning aapne bata di lekin ye AI kya hota hai? Ye deep learning kya hota hai? Ye generative AI kya hota hai? Deep learning hota hai neural network ko banana jo ki ek function ko approximate karte hain. Wo function assume kiya jata hai ki jo data humein diya hua hai us par ekdum fit baithega aur aane wale data points ko bhi wo bahut achi tarah se predict karega. Neural network basically ek bahut complex function ko, yani ki aisa complex function jiske baare mein insaan kalpana bhi nahi kar sakta hai, us pe bahut saare data points ko approximate kar sakta hai. Agar main aapse kahun teen char ka saat aur main kahun ek do ka teen aur main aapse kahun char char ka aath, toh aap samajh jaoge yaar add kiya ja raha hai toh function ekdum simple hai X plus Y. Lekin kabhi kabhi function itna complex hota hai ki aap us function ko kuch is prakar se banana chahte ho ki wo bahut hi accurately aur realistically data par baith raha hai. Toh iske liye hum log deep learning ka prayog karte hain jisme ki hum log artificial neural networks ka prayog karte hain. Artificial neural networks basically ek function ko approximate karte hain. Baar baar hum data ko feed karte hain uske saath aur error ko minimize karte hain. Is process ko hum log training kehte hain. Ab hamare paas feed-forward neural networks hote hain, hamare paas backward propagation ke methods hote hain. Phir neural networks ke bhi alag alag prakar hote hain jaise ki CNN (Convolutional Neural Network), RNN (Recurrent Neural Network). Usi ke saath saath LSTMs hote hain (Long Short-Term Memory wale neural networks). Inko longer sequences aur vanishing gradient problem ko jo hai solve karne ke liye banaya gaya hai. Maine bahut pehle ek video banaya tha jisme maine vanishing gradient problem ke baare mein baat ki thi kya hoti hai. Toh aap log dekh sakte ho, kaafi pehle maine wo videos dale the machine learning ke toh aap log agar interested ho toh unko dobara watch kar sakte ho, maine board par bahut hi classical tareeke se samjhaya hua hai usme.

text: Phir hamare paas autoencoders hote hain, GANs hote hain (Generative Adversarial Networks). GAN yes Generative Adversarial Networks jo ki basically generative AI ki taraf ek kadam tha. Pehle LSTMs ka istemal kiya jata tha lekin jabse transformers aaye jo ki again ek tarah ka neural network hi hai, ek neural network architecture hai such that aap log NLP pe data ko train kar pao bahut hi easily toh aap uska prayog karke ChatGPT jaisi cheez par arrive kar sakte ho. But again, it's not that easy, aap logo ko iske basics ko samajhna padega. Uske baad aap logo ko ye dekhna hoga ki transformer ka kya architecture hota hai, transformer kya hota hai, attention kya hota hai. Kyun banaya gaya LSTMs mein kya problem thi ki transformers par hum log switch kiye aur ek transformer ka architecture kis tarah se naye data ko generate karta hai purane data ko dekhkar. Kis tarah se numbers mein encode kiya jata hai is saari textual information ko such that ki wo predict kar raha hai hamara next token.
